Agreement or a material obligation without prior written consent; use of a technical vendor is not itself an assignment.

the territory, period, mode and security conditions.

payment.text:
Article 7 (Consideration and Payment)
Total consideration is 193,000.00 USD, payable in USD. Licensee shall pay it as follows: 30% (57,900.00 USD, within
10 business days after signing); 70% (135,100.00 USD, within 15 business days after delivery). The stated amounts
exclude applicable indirect taxes.

Article 5 (Delivery and Acceptance)
By the agreed delivery date, Licensor shall provide serviceable picture or audio masters, available subtitle or script
materials, approved stills and core metadata by secure transfer.
Licensee shall inspect technical conformity within ten business days and give particularised notice of material defects.
Failure to give timely technical notice does not waive a latent chain-of-title claim.
